verses.text: We have heard with our ears, God; our fathers have told us what work you did in their days, in the days of old.
lines: We have heard with our ears, God;
our fathers have told us what work you did in their days,
in the days of old.

verses.text: You drove out the nations with your hand, but you planted them. You afflicted the peoples, but you spread them abroad.
lines: You drove out the nations with your hand,
but you planted them.
You afflicted the peoples,
but you spread them abroad.

verses.text: For they didn’t get the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them; but your right hand, your arm, and the light of your face, because you were favorable to them.
lines: For they didn’t get the land in possession by their own sword,
neither did their own arm save them;
but your right hand, your arm, and the light of your face,
because you were favorable to them.

verses.text: You are my King, God. Command victories for Jacob!
lines: You are my King, God.
Command victories for Jacob!

verses.text: Through you, will we push down our adversaries. Through your name, we will tread down those who rise up against us.
lines: Through you, will we push down our adversaries.
Through your name, we will tread down those who rise up against us.

verses.text: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.
lines: For I will not trust in my bow,
neither shall my sword save me.

verses.text: But you have saved us from our adversaries, and have shamed those who hate us.
lines: But you have saved us from our adversaries,
and have shamed those who hate us.

verses.text: In God we have made our boast all day long, we will give thanks to your name forever.
lines: In God we have made our boast all day long,
we will give thanks to your name forever.

verses.text: But now you rejected us, and brought us to dishonor, and don’t go out with our armies.
lines: But now you rejected us, and brought us to dishonor,
and don’t go out with our armies.

verses.text: You make us turn back from the adversary. Those who hate us take plunder for themselves.
lines: You make us turn back from the adversary.
Those who hate us take plunder for themselves.

verses.text: You have made us like sheep for food, and have scattered us among the nations.
lines: You have made us like sheep for food,
and have scattered us among the nations.

verses.text: You sell your people for nothing, and have gained nothing from their sale.
lines: You sell your people for nothing,
and have gained nothing from their sale.

verses.text: You make us a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and a derision to those who are around us.
lines: You make us a reproach to our neighbors,
a scoffing and a derision to those who are around us.

verses.text: You make us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.
lines: You make us a byword among the nations,
a shaking of the head among the peoples.

verses.text: All day long my dishonor is before me, and shame covers my face,
lines: All day long my dishonor is before me,
and shame covers my face,

verses.text: at the taunt of one who reproaches and verbally abuses, because of the enemy and the avenger.
lines: at the taunt of one who reproaches and verbally abuses,
because of the enemy and the avenger.

verses.text: All this has come on us, yet we haven’t forgotten you. We haven’t been false to your covenant.
lines: All this has come on us,
yet we haven’t forgotten you.
We haven’t been false to your covenant.

verses.text: Our heart has not turned back, neither have our steps strayed from your path,
lines: Our heart has not turned back,
neither have our steps strayed from your path,

verses.text: though you have crushed us in the haunt of jackals, and covered us with the shadow of death.
lines: though you have crushed us in the haunt of jackals,
and covered us with the shadow of death.

verses.text: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or spread out our hands to a strange god,
lines: If we have forgotten the name of our God,
or spread out our hands to a strange god,

verses.text: won’t God search this out? For he knows the secrets of the heart.
lines: won’t God search this out?
For he knows the secrets of the heart.

verses.text: Yes, for your sake we are killed all day long. We are regarded as sheep for the slaughter.
lines: Yes, for your sake we are killed all day long.
We are regarded as sheep for the slaughter.

verses.text: Wake up! Why do you sleep, Lord? Arise! Don’t reject us forever.
lines: Wake up!
Why do you sleep, Lord?
Arise!
Don’t reject us forever.

verses.text: Why do you hide your face, and forget our affliction and our oppression?
lines: Why do you hide your face,
and forget our affliction and our oppression?

verses.text: For our soul is bowed down to the dust. Our body clings to the earth.
lines: For our soul is bowed down to the dust.
Our body clings to the earth.

verses.text: Rise up to help us. Redeem us for your loving kindness’ sake.
lines: Rise up to help us.
Redeem us for your loving kindness’ sake.
